metadata.description: Optional agent workflow plugins for Home Assistant custom integration developers. Not affiliated with Home Assistant or the Open Home Foundation.

plugins.name: haci-plan
plugins.description: Settle requirements before code: interview the developer, then plan large changes in phases.

plugins.name: haci-review
plugins.description: Review a change before it is committed: simplify, rerun the gates, then a reviewer that did not write it.

plugins.name: haci-triage
plugins.description: Work through a backlog of GitHub issues one at a time, each fix on its own branch and pull request.
